description: Instruction-driven in-place PDF text updater. Extracts page text for analysis, LLM-emits exact old→new substring patches, applies overlay edits on the original PDF (images/layout preserved). Does not author documents from scratch.

pdf_path.description: Filesystem path to the source PDF to edit in place.

instruction.description: Natural-language change instructions describing the desired final text state.

output_pdf_path.description: Destination path for the updated PDF; defaults to <stem>_updated.pdf beside the source.

json_dir.description: Optional directory for page-extract and patch JSON artifacts.

updated_pdf_path.description: Path to the modified PDF after in-place overlay edits.

applied_updates.description: Structured diff of patches that matched and were applied (page, old, new).

proposed_updates.description: Full LLM-proposed patch list before apply filtering.

dispatch_output.description: Canonical product of this agent: modified PDF path + structured patch list — not a free-form generated document.
